questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Which planet is the hottest in our solar system?

explanation.en: Venus is the hottest planet, about 467 C, because its thick air traps heat.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

explanation.en: Venus has no moons and no rings.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: On Venus the Sun rises in the west and sets in the east.

explanation.en: Venus spins backward compared with most planets, so the Sun rises in the west.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Order these by how bright they look from Earth, brightest first.

explanation.en: After the Sun and the Moon, Venus is the brightest natural object in our sky.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: What makes the surface of Venus so hot?

explanation.en: Venus's thick carbon dioxide atmosphere traps heat in a runaway greenhouse effect.

choices: Being the closest planet to the Sun

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Match each Venus fact to its value.

explanation.en: Venus spins very slowly, is extremely hot, and its air presses down 93 times harder than Earth's.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Put these planets in order from smallest to largest.

explanation.en: Mercury is the smallest planet. Venus (12,104 km wide) is a little smaller than Earth.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: One spin of Venus on its axis takes longer than one Venus year.

explanation.en: Venus takes 243 Earth days to spin once but only 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: What did Galileo's observations of the phases of Venus support?

explanation.en: Venus showing phases like the Moon helped support the idea that planets orbit the Sun.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Order these planets by average distance from the Sun, nearest first.

explanation.en: Mercury is 1st, Venus 2nd, Mars 4th and Jupiter 5th planet from the Sun.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T3 Bab 10 Penerokaan Angkasa Lepas

prompt.en: Match each name to what it did at Venus.

explanation.en: Radar could see through the clouds; Venera landers survived briefly on the hot surface.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: How does the width of Venus compare with Earth's?

explanation.en: Venus is 12,104 km across; Earth is 12,756 km. They are almost twins in size.
